' IDE bridge: resource bootstrap is offline; network/replacement run in the native sidecar.
Private Class UpdaterController
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function CurrentPid Lib "kernel32" Alias "GetCurrentProcessId" () As Long
    Private mHost As Host
    Private mWindow As ToolWindow
    Private mRoot As String
    Private mHome As String
    Private mSession As String
    Private mContext As String
    Private mLastState As String
    Private mBusy As Boolean
    Private mClosing As Boolean
    Private mCanApprove As Boolean
    Private mExitRequested As Boolean
    Private mInstalled As Boolean
    Private mBundle As BundledResources
    Private mRefreshAt As Date
    Private mAckId As String
    Private mAckOk As Boolean
    Private mThemeSource As String
    Private mThemeCatalog As UpdateJson
    Private mCatalogAccent As String
    Private mDiscoveryDeadline As Date
    Private mPolling As Boolean
    Private mLastPalette As String
    Private mLastViewTheme As String
    Private mLastViewToolbar As String
    Private mMessage As String
    Private mPreferenceFault As String
    Private mFallback As UpdateJson

    Public Sub New(ByVal host As Host)
        Set mHost = host
        mRoot = LCompilerRoot(): mHome = IHome(mRoot)
        Set mBundle = New BundledResources
        mBundle.Refresh
        IRegister mRoot
        On Error GoTo SettingsUnreadable
        If Not UExists(USafe(mHome, "settings.json")) Then
            Dim defaults As UpdateJson = ISettings(mRoot)
            defaults.Assign "automatic", JB(GetSetting("tbUI3Updater", "Options", "Automatic", "1") = "1")
            defaults.Assign "deferredUntil", JN(Val(GetSetting("tbUI3Updater", "Options", "DeferredUntil", "0")))
            defaults.Assign "lastCheck", JS(GetSetting("tbUI3Updater", "Options", "LastCheck", ""))
            ISaveSettings mRoot, defaults
        End If
        Dim checked As UpdateJson = ISettings(mRoot)
        GoTo BootstrapReady
    SettingsUnreadable:
        mPreferenceFault = Err.Description
        Resume BootstrapReady
    BootstrapReady:
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Len(mPreferenceFault) > 0 Then
            Set mFallback = IDefaultSettings(mRoot): mFallback.Assign "automatic", JB(False)
            mMessage = "Existing installation settings were preserved. Back up and reset them explicitly before changing preferences or checking updates."
        End If
        mRefreshAt = DateAdd("s", 30, Now)
        RestorePending
    End Sub
    Private Function ReadPreferences() As UpdateJson
        If Len(mPreferenceFault) > 0 Then
            Set ReadPreferences = mFallback
        Else
            Set ReadPreferences = ISettings(mRoot)
        End If
    End Function
    Private Function Eval(ByVal expression As String) As String
        If mWindow Is Nothing Then Set mWindow = mHost.ToolWindows.Add("tbUI3 updates", "tbUI3UpdaterHost")
        ' A script whose last statement yields no value comes back as Null or Empty; treat both as no text.
        Dim result As Variant
        result = mWindow.RootDomElement.Properties.ownerDocument.defaultView.eval(expression)
        If IsNull(result) Or IsEmpty(result) Then Return ""
        Return CStr(result)
    End Function
    Private Function ReadText(ByVal path As String) As String
        If Not UExists(path) Then Return ""
        UNoLinks path
        Return UText(path)
    End Function
    Private Sub Launch(ByVal mode As String, Optional ByVal context As String = "")
        Select Case mode
            Case "Check", "Stage", "Cancel", "Recover"
            Case Else: UFail "Unsupported add-in updater action."
        End Select
        If Not MHelperReady() Then UFail "The shared updater is missing, unrecognized or incompatible. Open tbUI3 installations to review repair status."
        If Len(context) = 0 Then context = mContext
        IValidateContext UReadJson(context), context
        Shell IQuoteArg(ISharedExe()) & " -Mode " & mode & " -Context " & IQuoteArg(context), vbHide
    End Sub
    Private Sub CreateSession(ByVal request As UpdateJson)
        Dim sessions As String = USafe(mHome, "Sessions")
        UDirectory sessions
        mSession = USafe(sessions, CStr(CurrentPid()) & "-" & UUnique())
        UDirectory mSession
        mContext = USafe(mSession, "context.json")
        mLastState = "": mExitRequested = False: mCanApprove = True
        If Len(mPreferenceFault) > 0 Then UFail "Reset the preserved, unrecognized settings before starting an update."
        Dim context As UpdateJson = JO(), settings As UpdateJson = ReadPreferences()
        context.Assign "schema", JN(IContextSchema): context.Assign "protocol", JN(IProtocol)
        context.Assign "installationId", JS(IId(mRoot)): context.Assign "stateRoot", JS(mHome)
        context.Assign "installRoot", JS(mRoot): context.Assign "ideExe", JS(USafe(mRoot, "twinBASIC.exe"))
        context.Assign "updaterPath", JS(ISharedExe()): context.Assign "originSid", JS(IUserSid())
        context.Assign "compilerPid", JN(CurrentPid()): context.Assign "compilerBirth", JS(UProcessTime(CurrentPid()))
        context.Assign "strategy", JS(IStrategy): context.Assign "channel", settings.Member("channel")
        context.Assign "clientMinIdeBuild", JN(Phase1Config.MinIdeBuild): context.Assign "clientMaxIdeBuild", JN(Phase1Config.MaxIdeBuild)
        context.Assign "selected", JA(): context.Assign "choice", JS(JT(request, "action"))
        context.Assign "restart", settings.Member("restart")
        If request.Has("selected") Then context.Assign "selected", request.Member("selected")
        If request.Has("restart") Then context.Assign "restart", request.Member("restart")
        UWriteJson mContext, context
    End Sub
    Private Function Snapshot() As UpdateJson
        Dim state As UpdateJson = JO(), settings As UpdateJson = ReadPreferences()
        state.Assign "schema", JN(1): state.Assign "root", JS(mRoot): state.Assign "installationId", JS(IId(mRoot))
        state.Assign "settingsError", JS(mPreferenceFault)
        state.Assign "preferences", settings: state.Assign "bootstrap", mBundle.Snapshot
        state.Assign "theme", JS(mHost.Themes.ActiveThemeName)
        state.Assign "themeMode", JS(LCase$(mHost.Themes.ActiveThemeNameGroup))
        state.Assign "accent", JParse(WinUI3SystemAccent.ReadPalette())
        state.Assign "installedThemes", InstalledThemes()
        Dim discovery As UpdateJson = JParse(mThemeSource), themeStatus As UpdateJson = JO()
        themeStatus.Assign "pending", discovery.Member("pending"): themeStatus.Assign "error", discovery.Member("error")
        state.Assign "themeDiscovery", themeStatus
        Dim ack As UpdateJson = JO(): ack.Assign "id", JS(mAckId): ack.Assign "ok", JB(mAckOk): state.Assign "ack", ack
        state.Assign "toolbar", JS(Eval("window.__tbUI3Toolbar?window.__tbUI3Toolbar.mode:''"))
        state.Assign "message", JS(mMessage): state.Assign "recovery", JB(Len(RecoveryContext()) > 0)
        Set Snapshot = state
    End Function
    Private Function InstalledThemes() As UpdateJson
        Dim raw As String = Eval("window.__tbUI3Themes.inventory()"), palette As String = WinUI3SystemAccent.ReadPalette(), accent As String
        If raw <> mThemeSource Or palette <> mCatalogAccent Or mThemeCatalog Is Nothing Then
            Dim colors As UpdateJson = JParse(palette)
            If colors.Kind = "array" Then
                If colors.Items.Count = 7 Then accent = colors.Items.Item(4).Text
            End If
            Set mThemeCatalog = TCatalog(JParse(raw), accent)
            mThemeSource = raw: mCatalogAccent = palette
        End If
        Set InstalledThemes = mThemeCatalog
    End Function
    Private Sub RefreshThemeDiscovery(Optional ByVal force As Boolean = False)
        If mBundle.Snapshot.Has("resources") Then
            Dim resource As UpdateJson
            For Each resource In mBundle.Snapshot.Member("resources").Items
                If (JT(resource, "id") = "themeDark" Or JT(resource, "id") = "themeLight") And JT(resource, "status") = "provisioned" Then force = True
            Next
        End If
        If Not force Then Exit Sub
        Eval "window.__tbUI3Themes.refresh();'theme discovery refreshed'"
        mDiscoveryDeadline = DateAdd("s", 15, Now)
    End Sub
    Private Function WelcomeNeeded() As Boolean
        Dim path As String = USafe(ISharedRoot(), "Shared/welcome.json")
        If Not UExists(path) Then Return True
        Dim record As UpdateJson = UReadJson(path)
        Return JD(record, "schema") < 1
    End Function
    Private Sub PublishPreferences()
        If Not mInstalled Then Exit Sub
        Dim state As String = Snapshot().Encode()
        Eval "(function(){var s=" & state & ";window.__tbUI3Installation.publish(s);window.__tbUI3Updater.setAppearance(s);window.__tbUI3Updater.setPreferences(" & ReadPreferences().Encode() & ");return 'settings synchronized';})()"
    End Sub
    Private Sub InitializeUI()
        Dim settings As UpdateJson = ReadPreferences()
        Eval "window.__tbUI3ThemeFactory=" & MResourceText("tbUI3-theme-service.js") & ";'theme service factory loaded'"
        Eval "window.__tbUI3Themes=window.__tbUI3ThemeFactory({themes:function(){return customThemes;},afterRefresh:function(){return afterRefreshedThemes;},setAfterRefresh:function(fn){afterRefreshedThemes=fn;},reload:function(){reloadThemesFromDisk();},current:function(){return liveIDEOptions.colorTheme;},setCurrent:function(name){liveIDEOptions.colorTheme=name;},save:function(){saveIDEOptions();},changed:function(){changedIdeOptions();},notify:function(){root.notifyChangedTheme();}});'installed theme adapter ready'"
        RefreshThemeDiscovery True
        Eval UpdaterScript.Build()
        Eval "window.__tbUI3Updater=" & UpdaterScript.Factory() & "({document:document,window:window,automatic:" & IIf(JBool(settings, "automatic"), "true", "false") & _
            ",restart:" & IIf(JBool(settings, "restart"), "true", "false") & ",deferredUntil:" & Trim$(Str$(JD(settings, "deferredUntil"))) & _
            ",checkDue:" & IIf(JT(settings, "lastCheck") <> Format$(Date, "yyyy-mm-dd"), "true", "false") & _
            ",masterCss:" & JQuote(MResourceText("tbUI3-welcome-master.css")) & _
            ",themeMode:function(){return typeof getBaseThemeName==='function'?getBaseThemeName():'light';},accent:" & WinUI3SystemAccent.ReadPalette() & _
            ",installationSettings:function(){window.__tbUI3Installation.show('settings');},closeIde:function(){closeProjectSafely(function(){window.__tbUI3UpdateExit=function(){hostAppObject.Exit('ignore');};});}});'updater installed'"
        Eval MResourceText("tbUI3-welcome.js") & vbLf & ";'welcome wizard loaded'"
        Eval "window.__tbUI3InstallationFactory=" & MResourceText("tbUI3-installation.js") & ";'installation factory loaded'"
        Eval "window.__tbUI3Installation=window.__tbUI3InstallationFactory({document:document,window:window,state:" & Snapshot().Encode() & _
            ",styles:" & JQuote(MResourceText("tbUI3-installation.css")) & ",dialogStyles:" & JQuote(MResourceText("tbUI3-dialog.css")) & _
            ",welcomeStyles:" & JQuote(MResourceText("tbUI3-welcome.css")) & ",welcomeMaster:" & JQuote(MResourceText("tbUI3-welcome-master.css")) & _
            ",welcomeControls:" & JQuote(MResourceText("tbUI3-welcome-controls.js")) & _
            ",showWelcome:" & IIf(WelcomeNeeded(), "true", "false") & ",canAutoWelcome:function(){var g=window.__tbUI3StartupWelcome;return !!g&&g.consume();},themeMode:function(){return typeof getBaseThemeName==='function'?getBaseThemeName():'light';},showUpdates:function(){window.__tbUI3Installation.hide();window.__tbUI3Updater.show();}});'installation UI loaded'"
        mInstalled = True
    End Sub
    Private Sub SavePreferences(ByVal request As UpdateJson)
        If Len(mPreferenceFault) > 0 Then UFail "Existing settings were preserved; use explicit reset first."
        IApplySettings mRoot, request
        mMessage = "Preferences saved for this IDE."
        PublishPreferences
    End Sub
    Private Sub SaveWelcome(ByVal request As UpdateJson)
        If JD(request, "schema") <> 1 Then UFail "Unsupported Welcome schema."
        Dim disposition As String = JT(request, "disposition")
        If disposition <> "completed" And disposition <> "dismissed" Then UFail "Invalid Welcome disposition."
        Dim path As String = USafe(ISharedRoot(), "Shared/welcome.json"), guard As LongPtr = IRequireLock("welcome")
        On Error GoTo Failed
        If UExists(path) Then
            If JD(UReadJson(path), "schema") > 1 Then IUnlock guard: Exit Sub
        End If
        Dim record As UpdateJson = JO()
        record.Assign "schema", JN(1): record.Assign "disposition", JS(disposition): record.Assign "saved", JS(Format$(Now, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss"))
        UDirectory UParent(path): UWriteJson path, record
        IUnlock guard: Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Dim reason As String = Err.Description
        IUnlock guard: UFail reason
    End Sub
    Private Sub ApplyTheme(ByVal name As String, ByVal requestId As String)
        ' The loader has already discovered these exact names. No second reload, and
        ' no asynchronous theme lock can survive a rejected or completed request.
        Dim theme As UpdateJson, allowed As Boolean
        For Each theme In InstalledThemes().Items
            If JT(theme, "name") = name Then allowed = True
        Next
        If Not allowed Then UFail "Choose an exact theme from the current installed IDE inventory."
        Dim raw As String = Eval("JSON.stringify(window.__tbUI3Themes.choose(" & JQuote(name) & "," & JQuote(requestId) & "))")
        Dim result As UpdateJson = JParse(raw)
        If JT(result, "requestId") <> requestId Then UFail "Unexpected theme confirmation."
        mAckOk = JBool(result, "ok")
        mMessage = JT(result, "message")
        If Not mAckOk Then mMessage = "Error: " & mMessage
    End Sub
    Private Function RecoveryContext() As String
        Dim path As String = USafe(mHome, "active.json")
        If Not UExists(path) Then Return ""
        Dim active As UpdateJson = UReadJson(path), context As String = JT(active, "context")
        If Not UExists(context) Then Return ""
        IValidateContext UReadJson(context), context
        Dim journal As String = USafe(UParent(context), "journal.json")
        If Not UExists(journal) Then Return ""
        Dim state As String = JT(UReadJson(journal), "status")
        If state = "complete" Or state = "rolledBack" Then Return ""
        Return context
    End Function
    Private Sub RestorePending()
        On Error GoTo Retain
        Dim path As String = USafe(mHome, "pending.json")
        If Not UExists(path) Then Exit Sub
        Dim pending As UpdateJson = UReadJson(path), context As String = JT(pending, "context"), saved As UpdateJson = UReadJson(context)
        IValidateContext saved, context
        If JT(saved, "compilerBirth") <> UProcessTime(CurrentPid()) Or JD(saved, "compilerPid") <> CurrentPid() Then
            mMessage = "A prior session was retained. It cannot inherit shutdown approval from this IDE session."
            Exit Sub
        End If
        mContext = context: mSession = UParent(context): mCanApprove = True
    Retain:
    End Sub
    Public Sub Poll()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        If mClosing Or mPolling Then Exit Sub
        mPolling = True
        Dim fromInstallation As Boolean
        If Not mInstalled Then InitializeUI
        If Now >= mRefreshAt Then
            mBundle.Refresh: RefreshThemeDiscovery: mRefreshAt = DateAdd("s", 30, Now): PublishPreferences
        End If
        Dim raw As String = Eval("window.__tbUI3Updater.take()")
        If Len(raw) = 0 Then
            raw = Eval("window.__tbUI3Installation.take()")
            fromInstallation = Len(raw) > 0
        End If
        If Len(raw) > 0 Then
            Dim request As UpdateJson = JParse(raw), action As String = JT(request, "action")
            mAckId = JT(request, "requestId"): mAckOk = True
            Select Case action
                Case "check"
                    If Not mBusy Then CreateSession request: Launch "Check": mBusy = True
                Case "now", "exit"
                    If Not mBusy And Len(mContext) > 0 Then
                        Dim catalog As UpdateJson = UReadJson(USafe(mSession, "catalog.json"))
                        CreateSession request: UWriteJson USafe(mSession, "catalog.json"), catalog
                        Launch "Stage": mBusy = True
                    End If
                Case "cancel"
                    If Len(mContext) > 0 Then Launch "Cancel"
                    Eval "window.__tbUI3UpdatePending=false;'cancel requested'"
                Case "preferences", "installation-preferences", "later": SavePreferences request
                Case "reset-installation-settings"
                    If Not JBool(request, "confirmed") Then UFail "Explicit settings reset approval is required."
                    ResetPreferences
                Case "reset-shared-resource-ledger"
                    If Not JBool(request, "confirmed") Then UFail "Explicit shared registry reset approval is required."
                    mBundle.ResetLedger: RefreshThemeDiscovery: PublishPreferences
                Case "bootstrap-retry"
                    mBundle.Refresh
                    RefreshThemeDiscovery True: PublishPreferences
                Case "repair-resource"
                    If Not JBool(request, "confirmed") Then UFail "Explicit resource reset approval is required."
                    Dim id As String = JT(request, "id")
                    If id <> "updater" And id <> "themeDark" And id <> "themeLight" Then UFail "Unsupported repair."
                    mBundle.Refresh id: RefreshThemeDiscovery: PublishPreferences
                Case "welcome-record": SaveWelcome request
                Case "choose-toolbar"
                    Dim mode As String = JT(request, "name")
                    If mode <> "Classic" And mode <> "Hybrid" And mode <> "Ribbon" Then UFail "Unsupported toolbar choice."
                    Eval "if(!window.__tbUI3Toolbar)throw Error('Toolbar is still starting. Retry shortly.');var t=window.__tbUI3Toolbar,previous=t.requestedMode,actual=t.setMode(" & JQuote(mode) & ",true);if(actual!==" & JQuote(mode) & "){var reason=t.lastError||'The requested toolbar could not be activated.';t.setMode(previous,true);throw Error(reason);}'toolbar changed'"
                    SaveSetting "WinUI3IdeStyle", "Options", "ToolbarMode", mode
                    mMessage = "Toolbar preference saved.": PublishPreferences
                Case "choose-theme": ApplyTheme JT(request, "name"), mAckId
                Case "open-recovery"
                    Dim recovery As String = RecoveryContext()
                    If Len(recovery) = 0 Then UFail "No incomplete native transaction is available."
                    Launch "Recover", recovery
                Case Else: UFail "Unsupported installation request."
            End Select
            PublishPreferences
            fromInstallation = False
        End If
        If Now > mDiscoveryDeadline Then
            Eval "window.__tbUI3Themes.timeout();'theme discovery deadline checked'"
        End If
        Dim catalogRaw As String = Eval("window.__tbUI3Themes.inventory()")
        If catalogRaw <> mThemeSource Then PublishPreferences
        Dim palette As String = WinUI3SystemAccent.ReadPalette(), actualTheme As String = mHost.Themes.ActiveThemeName
        Dim actualToolbar As String = Eval("window.__tbUI3Toolbar?window.__tbUI3Toolbar.mode:''")
        If palette <> mLastPalette Or actualTheme <> mLastViewTheme Or actualToolbar <> mLastViewToolbar Then
            mLastPalette = palette: mLastViewTheme = actualTheme: mLastViewToolbar = actualToolbar
            PublishPreferences
        End If
        If Len(mSession) = 0 Then GoTo Finished
        Dim result As String = ReadText(USafe(mSession, "state.json"))
        If Len(result) > 0 And result <> mLastState Then
            mLastState = result
            Dim state As UpdateJson = JParse(result), status As String = JT(state, "status")
            Eval "window.__tbUI3Updater.publish(" & result & ");'update state published'"
            mBusy = status = "checking" Or status = "staging" Or status = "ready" Or status = "waiting" Or status = "installing"
            If status = "checked" Then
                Dim checkPatch As UpdateJson = JO()
                checkPatch.Assign "lastCheck", JS(Format$(Date, "yyyy-mm-dd")): IApplySettings mRoot, checkPatch
            End If
            If status = "error" Or status = "cancelled" Or status = "complete" Or status = "rolledBack" Then Eval "window.__tbUI3UpdatePending=false;'pending ended'"
            If (status = "ready" Or status = "waiting") And mCanApprove Then
                Eval "window.__tbUI3UpdatePending=true;'pending'"
                If status = "waiting" And Not mExitRequested And JT(state, "choice") = "now" Then
                    mExitRequested = True: Eval "window.__tbUI3Updater.closeIde();'normal shutdown requested'"
                End If
            End If
        End If
        If mCanApprove And Eval("typeof window.__tbUI3UpdateExit==='function'?'yes':'no'") = "yes" Then
            Dim approval As UpdateJson = JO()
            approval.Assign "schema", JN(1): approval.Assign "normalShutdown", JB(True): approval.Assign "installationId", JS(IId(mRoot))
            approval.Assign "contextSha256", JS(UHash(mContext)): approval.Assign "planSha256", JS(UHash(USafe(mSession, "plan.json")))
            UWriteJson USafe(mSession, "approved.json"), approval
            mClosing = True
            Eval "(function(){var next=window.__tbUI3UpdateExit;delete window.__tbUI3UpdateExit;next();return 'normal exit resumed';})()"
        End If
    Finished:
        mPolling = False
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Dim reason As String = Err.Description
        mMessage = "Error: " & reason: mAckOk = False
        On Error Resume Next
        ' A wizard/appearance failure must not cancel an independent native update
        ' or replace its current transaction status with an unrelated message.
        If Not fromInstallation Then
            mBusy = False
            Eval "if(window.__tbUI3Updater)window.__tbUI3Updater.publish({status:'error',message:" & JQuote(reason) & "});'request failed'"
        End If
        PublishPreferences
        mHost.DebugConsole.PrintText "[tbUI3 updater] " & reason
        mPolling = False
    End Sub
    Public Sub Dispose()
        On Error Resume Next
        If mInstalled Then Eval "if(window.__tbUI3Installation)window.__tbUI3Installation.dispose();delete window.__tbUI3Installation;if(window.__tbUI3Updater)window.__tbUI3Updater.dispose();delete window.__tbUI3Updater;'updater UI removed'"
        If mInstalled Then Eval "if(closeProjectSafely===window.__tbUI3UpdaterCloseHook)closeProjectSafely=window.__tbUI3UpdaterOriginalClose;delete window.__tbUI3UpdaterFactory;delete window.__tbUI3InstallationFactory;delete window.__tbUI3ThemeFactory;if(window.__tbUI3Themes)window.__tbUI3Themes.dispose();delete window.__tbUI3Themes;delete window.__tbUI3UpdatePending;'hooks removed'"
        Set mWindow = Nothing: Set mHost = Nothing
    End Sub
    Private Sub ResetPreferences()
        Dim guard As LongPtr = IRequireLock("settings-" & IId(mRoot))
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Dim path As String = USafe(mHome, "settings.json"), backup As String = USafe(mHome, "Repairs/" & UUnique() & "/settings.json")
        If UExists(path) Then
            UDirectory UParent(backup): UCopy path, backup: UFlush backup
            If UHash(path) <> UHash(backup) Then UFail "Settings backup changed during verification."
        End If
        Dim settings As UpdateJson = IDefaultSettings(mRoot)
        settings.Assign "automatic", JB(False)
        ISaveSettings mRoot, settings
        IUnlock guard: guard = 0
        mPreferenceFault = "": Set mFallback = Nothing
        mMessage = "Settings reset with automatic checks off. Preserved backup: " & backup
        PublishPreferences
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Dim reason As String = Err.Description
        IUnlock guard: UFail reason
    End Sub
End Class

Module MainModule
    [DllExport]
    Public Function tbCreateCompilerAddin(ByVal Host As Host) As AddIn
        ' Entry point the twinBASIC IDE calls for every add-in DLL in its addins\win32 or addins\win64 folder.
        ' The IDE releases the returned object when it unloads the add-in.
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Dim token As LongPtr = LBegin(AddressOf tbCreateCompilerAddin, Host)
        If token = 0 Then Return Nothing
        Dim instance As tbUI3IDEAddin = New tbUI3IDEAddin(Host)
        instance.OwnFactoryToken token
        token = 0
        Return instance
    Failed:
        Dim reason As String = Err.Description
        LEnd token
        Host.DebugConsole.PrintText "[tbUI3IDE] could not initialize: " & reason
        Return Nothing
    End Function
End Module

Private Class tbUI3IDEAddin

    Implements AddIn

    ' Theme-only style element; the TabView controller owns a separate functional stylesheet.
    Private Const StyleElementId As String = "winui3IdeStyleCss"
    Private Const LogPrefix As String = "[tbUI3IDE] "

    Private WithEvents Host As Host
    ' A hidden tool window. Its body lives in a shadow root inside the IDE page, so its
    ' ownerDocument is the IDE page itself, which is how the stylesheet reaches the whole IDE.
    Private StyleWindow As ToolWindow
    ' Re-checks the theme a moment after start-up and project load. The IDE restores the project's
    ' state and clears the Debug Console after loading add-ins, which hid the first log lines.
    Private WithEvents SettleTimer As AddinTimer
    ' Picks up a change to the add-in's own option in IDE Options (see InstallOption) and saves it.
    Private WithEvents OptionTimer As AddinTimer
    Private LoadToken As LongPtr
    Private Updater As UpdaterController
    Private TabDesigner As TabViewDesignerController
    Private LastThemeName As String
    Private ToolbarInstalled As Boolean
    Private ToolbarLastError As String

    ' The add-in's on/off option, saved per user (HKCU\Software\VB and VBA Program Settings).
    Private Const SettingsApp As String = "WinUI3IdeStyle"
    Private Const SettingsSection As String = "Options"
    Private Const SettingEnabled As String = "Enabled"
    Private Const SettingToolbar As String = "ToolbarMode"
    Private Const SettingSimplified As String = "SimplifiedRibbon"
    ' Label of the IDE Options row the add-in's option goes under.
    Private Const OptionAnchor As String = "Colour Theme"
    Private Const OptionName As String = "Enable additional IDE theme styling via add-in"
    ' The IDE's own panel titles (English), in the sentence case WinUI uses. The IDE hard-codes them in capitals,
    ' which CSS cannot undo, so the page script rewrites them (see InstallOption). Titles in other languages and
    ' add-in tool windows are left alone. A trailing number (EDITOR 1) is kept.
    Private Const PanelTitles As String = "{'EDITOR':'Editor','PROJECT EXPLORER':'Project explorer','OPEN EDITORS':'Open editors'," & _
        "'HISTORY':'History','OUTLINE':'Outline','CALL STACK':'Call stack','VARIABLES':'Variables','WATCHES':'Watches'," & _
        "'DEBUG CONSOLE':'Debug console','DIAGNOSTICS':'Diagnostics','PACKAGE PUBLISHING':'Package publishing','TOOLBAR':'Toolbar'," & _
        "'TOOLBOX':'Toolbox','PROPERTIES':'Properties','WEBPAGE':'Webpage','FIND / REPLACE':'Find / replace','FIND REPLACE':'Find / replace'," & _
        "'IDE TRACE OUTPUT':'IDE trace output','MEMORY':'Memory'}"
    Private Const OptionDesc As String = "The WinUI3 IDE Style add-in restyles what the theme cannot reach, such as the toolbar, " & _
        "dialogs and lists. Turn it off to see the WinUI3 theme on its own. Tab management stays enabled. Takes effect at once."

    Public Sub New(ByVal Host As Host)
        Set Me.Host = Host
        ' Automatic Welcome is allowed only during the initial idle startup window.
        ' Register before toolbar/bootstrap work; do not take focus from a working user.
        On Error Resume Next
        RunJs "(function(){if(window.__tbUI3StartupWelcome)return 'startup gate ready';var start=performance.now(),used=false;" & _
            "var mark=function(e){if(e.isTrusted)used=true;};document.addEventListener('pointerdown',mark,true);document.addEventListener('keydown',mark,true);" & _
            "var dispose=function(){document.removeEventListener('pointerdown',mark,true);document.removeEventListener('keydown',mark,true);};" & _
            "window.__tbUI3StartupWelcome={consume:function(){var allow=!used&&performance.now()-start<=2500;used=true;dispose();return allow;},dispose:dispose};return 'startup gate ready';})()"
        On Error GoTo 0
        Set TabDesigner = New TabViewDesignerController(Host)
        Log "loaded: " & Architecture() & ", IDE compiler " & SafeCompilerVersion()
        ApplyForActiveTheme "start-up"
        StartSettleTimer
        On Error GoTo UpdaterFailed
        Set Updater = New UpdaterController(Host)
        Exit Sub
    UpdaterFailed:
        Log "updater initialization failed: " & Err.Description
    End Sub

    Public Sub OwnFactoryToken(ByVal token As LongPtr)
        LoadToken = token
    End Sub
    Private Sub Class_Terminate()
        On Error Resume Next
        If ToolbarInstalled Then
            OptionTimer_Timer
            OptionTimer_Timer
            OptionTimer_Timer
        End If
        If Not SettleTimer Is Nothing Then SettleTimer.Enabled = False
        If Not OptionTimer Is Nothing Then OptionTimer.Enabled = False
        Set SettleTimer = Nothing
        Set OptionTimer = Nothing
        If Not TabDesigner Is Nothing Then TabDesigner.Dispose
        Set TabDesigner = Nothing
        If Not Updater Is Nothing Then Updater.Dispose
        Set Updater = Nothing
        If Not StyleWindow Is Nothing Then
            RunJs "if(window.__tbUI3StartupWelcome)window.__tbUI3StartupWelcome.dispose();delete window.__tbUI3StartupWelcome;'startup gate removed'"
            RunJs "(function(){var t=window.__tbUI3Toolbar;if(t)t.dispose();delete window.__tbUI3Toolbar;if(window.__tbUI3Appearance)window.__tbUI3Appearance.dispose();delete window.__tbUI3Appearance;var s=document.getElementById('tbUI3ToolbarCss');if(s)s.remove();return 'toolbar removed';})()"
        End If
        ClearStyle
        If Not StyleWindow Is Nothing Then
            RunJs "(function(){var s=window.__winui3IdeStyle;if(s&&s.observer)s.observer.disconnect();if(s&&s.themeObserver)s.themeObserver.disconnect();" & _
                "document.querySelectorAll('.winui3IdeStyleOptionRow').forEach(function(r){r.remove();});" & _
                "delete window.__winui3IdeStyle;return 'theme option removed';})()"
        End If
        Set StyleWindow = Nothing
        LEnd LoadToken: LoadToken = 0
    End Sub

    Private Property Get AddIn_Name() As String
        Return "tbUI3IDE"
    End Property

    Private Sub Host_OnProjectLoaded()
        If Not TabDesigner Is Nothing Then TabDesigner.ProjectLoaded
        ApplyForActiveTheme "project loaded"
        StartSettleTimer
    End Sub

    Private Sub StartSettleTimer()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        If SettleTimer Is Nothing Then Set SettleTimer = New AddinTimer
        SettleTimer.Enabled = False
        SettleTimer.Interval = 2000
        SettleTimer.Enabled = True
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log "could not start the settle timer: " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    Private Sub SettleTimer_Timer()
        SettleTimer.Enabled = False
        ApplyForActiveTheme "2 seconds after loading"
    End Sub

    Private Sub Host_OnChangedTheme(ByVal ThemeName As String)
        ' ThemeName is only the theme group ("dark" or "light"), so ask for the theme itself.
        ApplyForActiveTheme "theme changed (event says " & ThemeName & ")"
    End Sub

    Private Sub ApplyForActiveTheme(ByVal Reason As String)
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Dim activeName As String = Host.Themes.ActiveThemeName
        Log Reason & ": theme is " & activeName & ", group " & Host.Themes.ActiveThemeNameGroup
        InstallToolbar
        ApplyForTheme activeName
        InstallOption
        UpdateSystemAccent
        LastThemeName = activeName
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log Reason & ": could not read the active theme: " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    Private Sub ApplyForTheme(ByVal ThemeName As String)
        ' The IDE reports theme names in lower case ("winui3 dark"), so compare without case.
        If LCase$(ThemeName) = "winui3 dark" Or LCase$(ThemeName) = "winui3 light" Then
            ApplyStyle ThemeName
        Else
            ClearStyle
        End If
    End Sub

    ' All page work goes through window.eval in the IDE page, the route the designer bridge probe
    ' proved on BETA 1043. Writing through property paths (getElementById(...).textContent = ...)
    ' reported success there without changing the page, so the stylesheet was never added.
    Private Sub ApplyStyle(ByVal ThemeName As String)
        Dim stepName As String
        On Error GoTo Failed
        stepName = "building the stylesheet"
        Dim css As String = WinUI3IdeCss.Build()
        stepName = "writing the style element"
        Log "page: " & RunJs("(function(){var s=document.getElementById('" & StyleElementId & "');var added=!s;" & _
            "if(added){s=document.createElement('style');s.id='" & StyleElementId & "';}" & _
            "s.textContent=" & JsString(css) & ";var st=window.__winui3IdeStyle;" & _
            "s.media=(st?st.enabled:" & IIf(OptionEnabled(), "true", "false") & ")?'all':'not all';document.head.appendChild(s);" & _
            "return (added?'added':'updated')+' the style element';})()")
        Log "stylesheet applied for " & ThemeName & " (" & Len(css) & " characters)"
        LogPageState
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log "could not apply the stylesheet while " & stepName & ": " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    Private Sub ClearStyle()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Log "page: " & RunJs("(function(){var s=document.getElementById('" & StyleElementId & "');" & _
            "if(!s)return 'no style element to remove';s.remove();if(window.__winui3IdeStyle&&window.__winui3IdeStyle.titles)window.__winui3IdeStyle.titles();" & _
            "return 'stylesheet removed';})()")
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log "could not remove the stylesheet: " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    ' Adds "Enable additional IDE theme styling via add-in" under Colour Theme in IDE Options. The IDE builds
    ' that dialog in script each time it opens (and again when it is filtered), so a MutationObserver adds the row
    ' whenever a Colour Theme row appears without it. The row reuses the dialog's own classes (tbis-optionRow,
    ' tbis-bool), so it looks like the IDE's other Yes / No options: a ToggleSwitch while the styling is on, the
    ' IDE's own No | Yes control while it is off. Switching it turns the stylesheet on or off at once through the
    ' style element's media attribute; OptionTimer then reads the change back and saves it.
    ' The same script puts the IDE's panel titles in sentence case (PanelTitles) while the styling is on, and
    ' puts the original text back when it is switched off or the theme is no longer WinUI3.
    ' The page script is written with single quotes only, so the twinBASIC strings need no Chr(34).
    Private Sub InstallOption()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Dim enabled As Boolean = OptionEnabled()
        Dim js As String = "(function(){var w=window,st=w.__winui3IdeStyle||(w.__winui3IdeStyle={});" & _
            "if(typeof st.enabled!=='boolean')st.enabled=" & IIf(enabled, "true", "false") & ";if(typeof st.dirty!=='boolean')st.dirty=false;" & _
            "st.syncTheme=function(){var name=typeof getThemeName==='function'?getThemeName():null;" & _
            "var root=document.documentElement,data=typeof activeThemeData==='object'&&activeThemeData;" & _
            "if(root&&data&&name!==null){var next={};Object.keys(data).forEach(function(k){next[k==='GlobalSearchMatchTextColorPart'?'--globalSearchMatchTextColorPart':'--theme'+k]=true;});" & _
            "if(st.pageTheme!==name&&st.palette)Object.keys(st.palette).forEach(function(k){var old=st.palette[k];" & _
            "if(!next[k]&&root.style.getPropertyValue(k)===old.value&&root.style.getPropertyPriority(k)===old.priority)root.style.removeProperty(k);});" & _
            "st.palette={};Object.keys(next).forEach(function(k){st.palette[k]={value:root.style.getPropertyValue(k),priority:root.style.getPropertyPriority(k)};});st.pageTheme=name;}" & _
            "return name===null||['winui3 dark','winui3 light'].includes(String(name).toLowerCase());};" & _
            "st.apply=function(){var eligible=st.syncTheme(),s=document.getElementById('" & StyleElementId & "');" & _
            "if(s&&!eligible){s.remove();s=null;}if(s)s.media=st.enabled?'all':'not all';if(w.__tbUI3Appearance)w.__tbUI3Appearance.sync();st.titles();};" & _
            "st.titleMap=" & PanelTitles & ";st.heads=st.heads||document.getElementsByClassName('sectionHeaderInner');" & _
            "st.titles=function(){var on=st.enabled&&!!document.getElementById('" & StyleElementId & "');" & _
            "for(var i=0;i<st.heads.length;i++){var h=st.heads[i],t=h.textContent,o=h.getAttribute('data-winui3-title');" & _
            "if(!on){if(o!==null){if(t===h.getAttribute('data-winui3-shown'))h.textContent=o;h.removeAttribute('data-winui3-title');h.removeAttribute('data-winui3-shown');}continue;}" & _
            "if(t===h.getAttribute('data-winui3-shown'))continue;var m=/^(.*?)(\s+\d+)?$/.exec(t),n=st.titleMap[m[1]];if(!n)continue;" & _
            "h.setAttribute('data-winui3-title',t);n+=(m[2]||'');h.setAttribute('data-winui3-shown',n);h.textContent=n;}};" & _
            "st.names=st.names||document.getElementsByClassName('tbis-optionName');" & _
            "st.row=function(){var r=document.createElement('div');r.className='tbis-optionRow winui3IdeStyleOptionRow';" & _
            "var l=document.createElement('div');l.className='tbis-optionLabelCol';var n=document.createElement('div');n.className='tbis-optionName';" & _
            "n.textContent=" & JsString(OptionName) & ";var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='tbis-optionDesc';" & _
            "d.textContent=" & JsString(OptionDesc) & ";l.appendChild(n);l.appendChild(d);" & _
            "var v=document.createElement('div');v.className='tbis-optionValueCol';var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='tbis-bool';" & _
            "var no=document.createElement('div'),yes=document.createElement('div');no.className=yes.className='tbis-boolSegment';no.textContent='No';yes.textContent='Yes';" & _
            "var show=function(){no.classList.toggle('tbis-boolSelected',!st.enabled);yes.classList.toggle('tbis-boolSelected',st.enabled);};" & _
            "var set=function(on){if(st.enabled===on)return;st.enabled=on;st.dirty=true;st.apply();show();};" & _
            "no.onclick=function(){set(false);};yes.onclick=function(){set(true);};show();" & _
            "b.appendChild(no);b.appendChild(yes);v.appendChild(b);r.appendChild(l);r.appendChild(v);return r;};" & _
            "st.scan=function(){st.titles();if(!st.names.length)return;" & _
            "for(var i=0;i<st.names.length;i++){var n=st.names[i];if(n.textContent.trim()!==" & JsString(OptionAnchor) & ")continue;" & _
            "var r=n.closest('.tbis-optionRow'),x=r&&r.nextElementSibling;" & _
            "if(r&&!(x&&x.classList.contains('winui3IdeStyleOptionRow')))r.after(st.row());}};" & _
            "if(!st.observer){st.observer=new MutationObserver(function(){st.scan();});st.observer.observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});}" & _
            "if(!st.themeObserver&&document.documentElement){st.themeObserver=new MutationObserver(function(){st.apply();});" & _
            "st.themeObserver.observe(document.documentElement,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style','class']});" & _
            "st.themeObserver.observe(document.body,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});}" & _
            "st.apply();st.scan();return 'option ready, styling '+(st.enabled?'on':'off');})()"
        Log "page: " & RunJs(js)
        If OptionTimer Is Nothing Then Set OptionTimer = New AddinTimer
        OptionTimer.Interval = 1000
        OptionTimer.Enabled = True
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log "could not add the IDE Options switch: " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    Private Sub InstallToolbar()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        If ToolbarInstalled Then Exit Sub
        Log "page: " & RunJs(IdeToolbarScript.Build())
        Dim mode As String = GetSetting(SettingsApp, SettingsSection, SettingToolbar, "Classic")
        If mode <> "Classic" And mode <> "Hybrid" And mode <> "Ribbon" Then mode = "Classic"
        RunJs "window.__tbUI3Toolbar.setMode(" & JsString(mode) & ",false);'toolbar mode restored'"
        RunJs "window.__tbUI3Toolbar.setSimplified(" & IIf(GetSetting(SettingsApp, SettingsSection, SettingSimplified, "0") = "1", "true", "false") & ",false);'ribbon presentation restored'"
        ToolbarInstalled = True
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log "could not initialize the toolbar: " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    Private Sub OptionTimer_Timer()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        If Not Updater Is Nothing Then Updater.Poll
        If Not ToolbarInstalled Then InstallToolbar
        ' Saving Colour Theme in BETA 1044 Options calls changedIdeOptions without notifyChangedTheme.
        ' Reconcile the actual name even when the host event was omitted; never reset unsaved page options.
        Dim activeName As String = Host.Themes.ActiveThemeName
        If StrComp(activeName, LastThemeName, vbTextCompare) <> 0 Then ApplyForActiveTheme "theme preference reconciled"
        UpdateSystemAccent
        Dim toolbarError As String = RunJs("window.__tbUI3Toolbar ? window.__tbUI3Toolbar.lastError : ''")
        If Len(toolbarError) > 0 And toolbarError <> ToolbarLastError Then Log "toolbar fallback: " & toolbarError
        ToolbarLastError = toolbarError
        Dim changed As String = RunJs("(function(){var t=window.__tbUI3Toolbar;if(t&&t.dirty){t.dirty=false;return 'toolbar:'+t.requestedMode;}" & _
            "if(t&&t.simplifiedDirty){t.simplifiedDirty=false;return t.simplified?'simple:1':'simple:0';}" & _
            "var s=window.__winui3IdeStyle;if(!s||!s.dirty)return '';s.dirty=false;return s.enabled?'theme:1':'theme:0';})()")
        If Len(changed) = 0 Then Exit Sub
        If Left$(changed, 8) = "toolbar:" Then
            SaveSetting SettingsApp, SettingsSection, SettingToolbar, Mid$(changed, 9)
            Log "toolbar mode saved: " & Mid$(changed, 9)
        ElseIf Left$(changed, 7) = "simple:" Then
            SaveSetting SettingsApp, SettingsSection, SettingSimplified, Mid$(changed, 8)
            Log "simplified ribbon saved: " & Mid$(changed, 8)
        ElseIf Left$(changed, 6) = "theme:" Then
            SaveSetting SettingsApp, SettingsSection, SettingEnabled, Mid$(changed, 7)
            Log "additional styling turned " & IIf(Mid$(changed, 7) = "1", "on", "off") & " in IDE Options (saved)"
        End If
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log "could not read IDE options: " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    ' Poll the documented Windows palette on the existing options timer. No external package,
    ' subprocess or registry accent approximation is needed; failed reads retain static theme colors.
    Private Sub UpdateSystemAccent()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Dim name As String = LCase$(Host.Themes.ActiveThemeName)
        If name <> "winui3 dark" And name <> "winui3 light" Then Exit Sub
        If RunJs("(window.__winui3IdeStyle&&window.__winui3IdeStyle.enabled)?'on':'off'") <> "on" Then Exit Sub
        Dim palette As String = WinUI3SystemAccent.ReadPalette()
        RunJs "(function(){var a=window.__tbUI3Appearance;if(a)a.setPalette(" & palette & ");return 'accent refreshed';})()"
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        ' The host may be loading/unloading. Retry on the existing one-second timer.
    End Sub

    ' On unless the user turned it off in IDE Options.
    Private Function OptionEnabled() As Boolean
        On Error Resume Next
        OptionEnabled = (GetSetting(SettingsApp, SettingsSection, SettingEnabled, "1") <> "0")
    End Function

    ' Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the IDE page and returns its result as text.
    ' The page is reached through a hidden tool window: its body sits in a shadow root on the
    ' IDE page, so its ownerDocument is the IDE page. Errors go to the caller.
    Private Function RunJs(ByVal Expr As String) As String
        If StyleWindow Is Nothing Then
            ' Tool windows start invisible, and this one stays that way.
            Set StyleWindow = Host.ToolWindows.Add("tbUI3IDE", "tbUI3IDEHost")
            StyleWindow.Title = "tbUI3IDE"
            Log "created the hidden tool window"
        End If
        Dim doc As Object
        Set doc = StyleWindow.RootDomElement.Properties.ownerDocument
        Return CStr(doc.defaultView.eval(Expr))
    End Function

    ' Text as a single-quoted JavaScript string literal.
    Private Function JsString(ByVal Text As String) As String
        Text = Replace(Text, "\", "\\")
        Text = Replace(Text, "'", "\'")
        Text = Replace(Text, vbCr, "\r")
        Text = Replace(Text, vbLf, "\n")
        Return "'" & Text & "'"
    End Function

    ' Reads back what the IDE page now holds, so a log shows whether the rules can take effect.
    ' It also moves the style element to the end of <head>, so it wins ties with the IDE's own
    ' stylesheets, and tests one rule for real: a temporary hidden menu item's computed background.
    Private Sub LogPageState()
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Dim js As String = "(function(){var s=document.getElementById('" & StyleElementId & "');" & _
            "if(!s)return 'no style element on the page';" & _
            "document.head.appendChild(s);" & _
            "var t=document.createElement('span');t.className='menuItem isMenuItemSelected';t.style.position='absolute';t.style.visibility='hidden';" & _
            "document.body.appendChild(t);var bg=getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor;t.remove();" & _
            "return (s.sheet?s.sheet.cssRules.length:'no sheet')+' of " & WinUI3IdeCss.RuleCount() & " rules parsed, '+s.textContent.length+' characters, '" & _
            "+'body.darkMode = '+document.body.classList.contains('darkMode')+', selected menu item background = '+bg+', starts with: '+s.textContent.slice(0,40);})()"
        Log "check: " & RunJs(js)
        Exit Sub
    Failed:
        Log "check failed: " & ErrorText()
    End Sub

    Private Function Architecture() As String
        #If Win64 Then
            Return "win64"
        #Else
            Return "win32"
        #End If
    End Function

    Private Function SafeCompilerVersion() As String
        On Error Resume Next
        SafeCompilerVersion = Host.CompilerVersion
    End Function

    Private Function ErrorText() As String
        Return "error " & Err.Number & " (&H" & Hex$(Err.Number) & "): " & Err.Description
    End Function

    Private Sub Log(ByVal Text As String)
        On Error Resume Next
        Host.DebugConsole.PrintText(LogPrefix & Text)
    End Sub

End Class

' Minimal private Windows Runtime ABI: Windows.UI.ViewManagement.IUISettings3.
' IID/vtable follow Windows SDK windows.ui.viewmanagement.h. The first three slots are
' IInspectable, never called here. This truncation matches Microsoft's WPF UISettingsRCW.
' https://github.com/dotnet/wpf/blob/main/src/Microsoft.DotNet.Wpf/src/PresentationCore/MS/internal/WindowsRuntime/Windows/UI/ViewManagement/UISettingsRcw.cs
[InterfaceId("03021BE4-5254-4781-8194-5168F7D06D7B")]
[OleAutomation(False)]
Private Interface IWinUI3Settings3 Extends stdole.IUnknown
    Sub Slot00_GetIids()
    Sub Slot01_GetRuntimeClassName()
    Sub Slot02_GetTrustLevel()
    ' Windows.UI.Color is exactly four bytes (A,R,G,B). A Long retval has the same ABI;
    ' ReadPalette converts its little-endian representation to CSS RGB explicitly.
    Function GetColorValue(ByVal desiredColor As Long) As Long
End Interface

Private Module WinUI3SystemAccent
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function RoInitialize Lib "combase" (ByVal initType As Long) As Long
    Private Declare PtrSafe Sub RoUninitialize Lib "combase" ()
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function WindowsCreateString Lib "combase" (ByVal source As LongPtr, ByVal length As Long, ByRef value As LongPtr) As Long
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function WindowsDeleteString Lib "combase" (ByVal value As LongPtr) As Long
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function RoActivateInstance Lib "combase" (ByVal classId As LongPtr, ByRef instance As stdole.IUnknown) As Long

    Public Function ReadPalette() As String
        Dim initialized As Boolean
        Dim classId As LongPtr
        Dim instance As stdole.IUnknown
        Dim settings As IWinUI3Settings3
        ReadPalette = "null"
        On Error GoTo Failed
        Dim hr As Long = RoInitialize(0) ' Single-threaded; use the existing apartment on RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE.
        initialized = (hr >= 0)
        If hr < 0 And hr <> &H80010106 Then GoTo Failed
        Dim runtimeName As String = "Windows.UI.ViewManagement.UISettings"
        If WindowsCreateString(StrPtr(runtimeName), Len(runtimeName), classId) < 0 Then GoTo Failed
        If RoActivateInstance(classId, instance) < 0 Then GoTo Failed
        Set settings = instance ' QueryInterface for IUISettings3, preserving HRESULT failures.
        Dim json As String = "["
        Dim desired As Long
        For desired = 8 To 2 Step -1 ' Light3, Light2, Light1, Accent, Dark1, Dark2, Dark3.
            Dim raw As String = Right$("00000000" & Hex$(settings.GetColorValue(desired)), 8)
            If desired <> 8 Then json = json & ","
            json = json & Chr$(34) & "#" & Mid$(raw, 5, 2) & Mid$(raw, 3, 2) & Left$(raw, 2) & Chr$(34)
        Next
        ReadPalette = json & "]"
    Failed:
        On Error Resume Next
        Set settings = Nothing
        Set instance = Nothing
        If classId <> 0 Then WindowsDeleteString classId
        If initialized Then RoUninitialize
    End Function
End Module
